modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Whatever your class, you may take one cabin bag and one accessory on board.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Cabin bag no larger than 55 cm long, 45 cm deep and 25 cm wide, including pockets, wheels and handles.

personal_item.value: One accessory (a handbag, laptop bag, camera bag or other electronic device bag) no larger than 40 cm long, 30 cm deep and 15 cm wide.

weight_international.value: International network: 1 bag and 1 accessory in Economy and Premium Economy (total weight 12 kg); 2 bags and 1 accessory in First and Business (total weight 18 kg).

weight_regional.value: Regional network: 1 bag and 1 accessory in both Economy and Business, total weight 10 kg.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: The checked allowance depends on your travel class and the network you fly.

allowance_domestic.value: Domestic network: one bag in Economy (max 23 kg per bag); one bag in Business (max 30 kg per bag).

allowance_regional.value: Regional network: 40 kg in Economy and 50 kg in Business, with a maximum of 32 kg per bag.

allowance_international.value: Johannesburg, Casablanca and future international destinations: 2 bags in Economy and Premium Economy (max 23 kg each), 2 bags in Business (max 32 kg each), 3 bags in First (max 32 kg).

infant_allowance.value: An infant under 2 gets a 10 kg allowance, plus a folding pushchair, carrycot or infant car seat.

excess_baggage.value: Extra baggage can be bought from 24 hours before departure until check-in; the price depends on the destination.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Air Côte d'Ivoire's conditions of carriage set out what it offers when it cancels or seriously delays a flight.

rebooking.value: If Air Côte d'Ivoire cancels a flight, operates it excessively late, skips your stop or makes you miss a connection on the same contract of carriage, it will, in agreement with you, carry you on another flight with a seat available at no extra cost, or reroute you on its own or another carrier's flights or by surface transport.

refund.value: If you accept neither option, the ticket is refunded: the full fare paid if no part was used, or the difference between the fare paid and the fare for the unflown part if partly used.

denied_boarding.value: If you are denied boarding because of overbooking after checking in on time, you are compensated in accordance with the applicable regulations.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
